email.subject: Bright Group Dentistry: two quick site fixes
email.body:
Hi Sam,

I checked Bright Group Dentistry's site. Two issues stood out: it's not optimized for mobile, and there's no way to book an appointment online. Since most people search for a dentist on their phone, a clunky mobile experience plus no booking option likely means visitors leave and call a competitor instead.

I fix exactly these kinds of issues for a flat fee, no retainer.

Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough showing what I'd change and why. No pressure either way.

Worth a quick look?

Alex
